questions.question:
A: What did you do last Sunday?
B: I ______ to the beach with my parents.
questions.explanation: 句子中出現 last Sunday（上週日），表示過去發生的動作，需使用 go 的過去式 went。
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能未注意到時間副詞，或不熟悉不規則動詞變化。

questions.question: We went to Taitung and ______ some delicious food there.
questions.explanation: 前半句 went 使用過去式，後半句為完成相同假期的描述，應維持過去式 ate。
questions.commonMisconception: 時態一致性（Tense Consistency）的概念薄弱。

questions.question: The weather was great, so we ______ hiking in the mountains.
questions.explanation: 從 was 可知情境為過去式，go hiking 的過去式為 went hiking。
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識 go hiking 固定用法或遺漏過去式轉化。

questions.question:
A: ______ you go camping last month?
B: No, I didn't. I stayed home.
questions.explanation: 詢問過去發生的動作，疑問句應使用助動詞 Did 開頭。
questions.commonMisconception: 受現在式習慣影響選用 Do，或受 stays home 的動詞屬性誤導選用 B 動詞 Were。

questions.question:
A: Where ______ Leo yesterday afternoon?
B: He was in the library.
questions.explanation: 詢問「地點/狀態」且對象是單數 Leo，時間是 yesterday，需選用 B 動詞過去式 was。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆助動詞 Did 與 B 動詞 Was。

questions.question:
A: What ______ Toby and Ken do during the winter break?
B: They visited their grandma in Tainan.
questions.explanation: 描述已結束的寒假活動，助動詞使用 did。主詞為複數但 did 不分單複數。
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能在複數主詞下猶豫是否要變換助動詞形式。

questions.question: I ______ at the party last night because I had a headache.
questions.explanation: 表達「不在場（狀態）」，主詞 I 對應 was，否定式為 wasn't。
questions.commonMisconception: 習慣性選 didn't，忽略了後方並無原形動詞。

questions.question: We ______ many beautiful photos in the park yesterday.
questions.explanation: 動詞 take 的不規則過去式是 took。
questions.commonMisconception: 誤以為所有過去式皆加 ed (taked)。

questions.question: She didn't ______ any milk this morning.
questions.explanation: 助動詞 didn't 之後應還原為「原形動詞」。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 this morning 過去時間強烈誘導而使用 drank。

questions.question:
Last week, Amy went to Taipei. She visited Taipei 101 and ate beef noodles. 
Question: What DIDN'T Amy do in Taipei?
questions.explanation: 文中只提到 101 與牛肉麵，並未提及去海邊 (go to the beach)。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒看清楚題目中的否定詞 DIDN'T。

questions.question:
Where was the cat? It wasn't in the kitchen. It was under the bed! 
Question: Was the cat in the kitchen?
questions.explanation: 文中表明 wasn't in the kitchen，且時態為過去式。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆現在式與過去式的簡答。

questions.question:
Dear Dad, I am having fun in Japan. I saw many deer yesterday. Tomorrow I will go to Tokyo. 
Question: When did the writer see the deer?
questions.explanation: 文中明確指出 'I saw many deer yesterday'。
questions.commonMisconception: 受時態雜揉影響（am having, saw, will go），無法精確提取特定事件的時間點。

questions.question:
Leo: 'I went to a museum last Friday.' 
Sam: 'Was it interesting?' 
Leo: 'No, it was boring.' 
Question: How did Leo feel about the museum?
questions.explanation: boring（無聊）對應的感受是「不感興趣」。
questions.commonMisconception: 不熟悉有趣 (interesting) 與無聊 (boring) 的反義對應。

questions.question:
It rained every day during our trip to Kenting. We stayed in the hotel and played cards. 
Question: Why didn't they go swimming?
questions.explanation: 文中提到下雨（rained every day），推論因天氣不好故待在室內玩牌。
questions.commonMisconception: 缺乏因果推論能力，直接選了文本中有出現的 activity (liked cards) 作為原因。

questions.question: Two years ago, many ______ lived in this small forest.
questions.explanation: wolf 的複數不規則變化為 wolves。
questions.commonMisconception: 不規則複數變化規則混淆。

questions.question: You should ______ many questions when you visit the Science Museum.
questions.explanation: 助動詞 should 之後應接原形動詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 visit 影響或誤以為描述狀況而變更動詞形式。

questions.question: Last Chinese New Year, we ______ red envelopes from our grandparents.
questions.explanation: 描述去年的春節活動，使用 get 的過去式 got。
questions.commonMisconception: 不知道 red envelopes 的文化脈絡，或是時態抓取錯誤。

questions.question: The ______ was in June last year. We saw a race on the river.
questions.explanation: 六月份且有河上競賽（race on the river），對應端午節（Dragon Boat Festival）。
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備節慶日期與習俗的英文化對應能力。

questions.question: On Halloween, the kids ______ 'Trick or treat!' and got many candies.
questions.explanation: 描述萬聖節當時的動作且後方 got 為過去式，故使用 said。
questions.commonMisconception: 習慣性選 say，忽視敘事時態一致性。

questions.question:
In summer, I went to the beach. In winter, I went to the mountains. 
Question: How many seasons are mentioned (提及)?
questions.explanation: 文中提及 summer（夏季）與 winter（冬季），共兩個季節。
questions.commonMisconception: 讀數目錯誤或不認識 season 這個單字。
